subject: HarborTech: continuity evidence request (RTO/RPO) & SOC2 tieouts
messages:
From: Lina Morales <lina@harbortech.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: HarborTech Audit <audit-team@harbortech.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO artifacts + SOC2 tieouts for onboarding

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. As part of HarborTech Financial's vendor onboarding and SOC2 mapping, the audit team has a short list of continuity evidence we need to collect from Redwood:

- RTO/RPO matrix by service (documented SLAs and measured recoveries)
- Recent warm failover traces or logs from a warm-standby activation (last 6 months)
- A one-page summary tying your recovery procedures to SOC2 CC6/CC7 control activities
- Availability to do a 30–45 minute live witness/demo session (we prefer May 20–22)

Could you confirm what you can share and a realistic date to deliver the items? We will treat any sensitive fields as confidential; if redaction is needed please flag it.

Appreciate it — Lina

--
Lina Morales
Vendor Risk Manager, HarborTech Financial
Audit: audit-team@harbortech.com
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Lina Morales <lina@harbortech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO artifacts + SOC2 tieouts for onboarding

Hi Lina —

Thanks for outlining the ask. High-level: we can provide a mapped package that covers all four bullets. Attached are the initial files (redacted where appropriate):

Attachments: 
- redwood_rto_rpo_matrix.xlsx (mapping per service and measured target/95th percentile recoveries)
- warm-failover-traces-20270428.log (sanitized trace; timestamps preserved; IPs redacted)
- standby_activation_screenshot.png (ops dashboard snapshot from the activation window)

Quick notes inline:
- RTO/RPO: Our documented targets are RTO=15 minutes for critical inference endpoints, RTO=60 minutes for non-critical management planes; RPO is 0 (KV cache persist + continuous replication) for critical flow and <= 15 minutes for others. The matrix includes both target and observed metrics from last quarter's drills.
- Warm failover traces: the attached log contains step-by-step activation markers; we've redacted customer identifiers and internal hostnames. If you need unredacted artifacts for live witness we can arrange a controlled view during the session.
- SOC2 tieouts: Ben is including a one-page control mapping (CC6/CC7) and Kimberly will confirm the audit artifacts we typically provide for long-term customers.

Live witness: May 20 or 21 (preferably 1400–1600 ET). If that works I will schedule an internal dry run on May 17 and circulate dial-in details.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm whether the attached redactions are acceptable or if HarborTech requires a scoped unredacted exhibit for the witness.
2) Confirm which date/time for the live witness.

If helpful I can also share a short (5–7 minute) video of the activation sequence ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Sofia

--
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Security & Compliance Liaison

Lina / team —

Following up from Sofia's package: quick operational points from our side.

- We will run a scheduled dry run (full warm-standby activation) on May 17 at 10:00 PT. Outcome artifacts (console video, activation logs, time-to-restore metrics) will be exported and shared by EOD May 18.
- The Excel matrix Sofia attached contains observed percentiles and the configuration that produced them; columns include: service_name, target_rto, observed_rto_p50, observed_rto_p95, target_rpo, observed_rpo_minutes, notes.
- If HarborTech needs a time-limited unredacted view, we prefer to host that during the witness rather than sending raw files ahead of time. We can provide a signed NDA addendum for sensitive items if required.

Forwarded for context below.

Thanks, Sofia and Ben — this looks good and very thorough. A few quick items: 

- May 20 at 14:00 ET works for the live witness. Please send a calendar invite with dial-in and the Drive link for the artifacts.
- We prefer the unredacted activation logs to be shown live rather than transferred; the NDA addendum sounds fine — I'll loop in legal if needed.
